goal: Allow users and external wallets to protect block ranges from automatic pruning on pruned nodes
Prevents blocks needed for future wallet rescans from being pruned away while a wallet is unloaded
reviewability: Ready for review; all earlier objections have been addressed
agreement: Concept support because it lets external wallets reliably operate on pruned nodes (stickies-v)
Approval following thread safety and startup option adjustments (sedited)
Earlier objection regarding RPC response extensibility was addressed by returning an object (luke-jr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adds new RPC commands for prune lock management to assist external wallets
Protects blocks needed for rescans but remains an opt-in management feature that is deferrable
